draft.subject: Embedded and Low Level Software Engineering Openings | Justin Mascarenhas
draft.body:
I am Justin Mascarenhas. I have an M.S. in Computer Engineering from Rochester Institute of Technology. I am writing about the embedded and low level software engineering openings at Interclypse. You lead technically on the software side, so you are closer than anyone to what these roles need day to day.

The stack in the posting lines up with what I have done. I have written C and C++ for STM32 microcontrollers at the bare metal level, programming GPIO, timers, ADC, and I2C registers directly, including a low level I2C driver and sample capture driven by interrupts. I have coordinated concurrent tasks under an RTOS using mutexes to guard shared memory. Python is my other main language and I used it to build real time data acquisition tooling in a research lab. On Linux I have deployed embedded software as a managed service with static networking.

I would appreciate the opportunity to discuss the role further, if your time allows. I can share my resume if that would be helpful.
draft.hook_used: Technical lead on the software side, closest to the real requirements of the low level reqs
